physicalNotes: Radius 0.8686 +/- 0.0133 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1248 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 604,285 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
